text: The Willow planning meetings (November 3–10) covered 26 modules and corrected several configuration values, including catalog ttl_s 390, session ttl_s 330, and upload batch_size 700. Ownership is split among three workers: gamma owns audit, ingest, and quota; delta owns search, billing, and sync; alpha owns shipping. Dependency rules forbid paths from archive to media, reports to scheduler, pricing to reports, and gateway to indexer. Client requirements set archive queue_depth to 450, quota max_workers to 20, ingest max_workers to 16, and search batch_size to 400. The rollout must deploy shipping and session before indexer. A security review is scheduled for month end. Linters, Rust rewrites, and runbook updates were deferred.
